query: Which statistical tests and multiplicity corrections will we prespecify for subgroup interaction analyses, what are acceptable performance-disparity thresholds, and which mitigation strategies will be triggered?

response.query: Which statistical tests and multiplicity corrections will we prespecify for subgroup interaction analyses, what are acceptable performance-disparity thresholds, and which mitigation strategies will be triggered?
response.answer: For subgroup interaction analyses, we will prespecify ANOVA or regression tests with Bonferroni correction for multiplicity. Acceptable performance-disparity thresholds will be set at p<0.05, and mitigation strategies will include re-evaluation of subgroup definitions.
